The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the present opposite-party Nos. 1-12 as plaintiffs instituted above numbered suit for the eviction of the present defendant-petitioners and opposite Party Nos. 13-16 from the suit land appertaining to CS plot No, 364 and 368 of CS khatian 46 of Tajruparamouja under Shariakandi Police Station of Bogra district comprising an area of 1,77 acres of land averring inter-alia that the land of CS khatian No, 46 was correctly recorded In the name of Meherullah Akond, Esharat Akond, Topljan Bibi, Serna Bibi, Syednesa Bibi, Panes Uddin Mondal, Idris Mondan, Ajirunnessa, Nojlbunnesa and Asmat ullah Mendalln different share. 

 4. One of the recorded tenant Esharat Ali died leaving daughter Fatema Khatun who filed Partition Suit No. 150 of 1951 for the partition of the land of CS khatian No. 46. In the said suit, Fazlar Rahman, the predecessor of the plaintiffs was defendant No. 16, the present plaintiff No.4 was defendant No. 23 and Ator Ali, the predecessor of the defendants was defendant No. 10. ln the said Partition Suit some of the defendants filed written statements in order to contest the suit and some of the co-sharers prayed for saham. 

 8. The defendant Nos. 2, 6 and 7 filing a joint written statement denied the material allegations of the plaint. The case of the defendants, in short, is that 71.92 acres of land appertaining CS to khatian No. 46 originally belong to Meherullah Akond and others in different share who mortgaged the land to Naimullah Fakir and accordingly CS khatian No. 76 was prepared in the name of Naimullah Fakir. One Kobej Mollah was the borgader under the Naimullah Fakir as such CS khatian No. 77 was also prepared in the name of Kobej Mollah articulating his possession thereon.
